body.p: Why partridge's eyelids are red. A partridge walked near one of the camps. There was no one in the outermost tent, everyone left. The partridge entered the tent. It did not find anything, there was nothing. Suddenly, it saw a woman's bag. In the bag it found a piece of read cloth. So it took the cloth from the bag. After the woman entered the tent, she immediately saw that someone had touched the bag. She did not find her red cloth. One day this woman went to check the snares. She is riding, collecting hares and partridges in snares. Suddenly she sees pieces of cloth hanging on the eyelids of one partridge. She was surprised: "That's who the thief is." So partridges' eyelids became red.
